checkpoints.name: Poker Creek / Beaver Creek (Alcan Port of Entry)

Named honesty debts carried: US HOS through-freight clock; CA truck caps; Blaine HGV refine.

speed_limits.source: Coarse placeholder ~55 mph rural Alaska Highway truck context for Phase A terminus; CA statutory truck caps and US HGV refine still named honesty debts (not a harvested maxspeed:hgv tag).

state_crossings.place: Poker Creek AK / Beaver Creek YT (Alcan Port of Entry) on the Alaska Highway
state_crossings.source: International border on the continuous Alaska Highway truck path at Alcan Port of Entry (Poker Creek); Canada Border Services Beaver Creek is ~18 mi prior. Position from OSM border_control matched to public Valhalla truck-costing geometry (development-time).
